steps.label: probe
steps.run:
cat > probe.py <<'EOF_PY'
import bpy, json, os, sys, uuid, urllib.request, urllib.parse, math
from mathutils import Vector
HOME = os.environ.get("AGENT_HOME", os.path.expanduser("~/ShortsRenderAgent"))
ADIR = os.path.join(HOME, "assets"); os.makedirs(ADIR, exist_ok=True)
BK = json.load(open("bk.json"))
UA = {"User-Agent": "blenderkit/3.21.3 (Blender 5.2.3)", "accept": "application/json"}
KEY = ""
for n, ad in bpy.context.preferences.addons.items():
    if "blenderkit" in n.lower(): KEY = getattr(ad.preferences, "api_key", "") or ""
out = []
def fetch(url, path):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": UA["User-Agent"]})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=600) as r, open(path + ".part", "wb") as f:
        while True:
            b = r.read(1 << 20)
            if not b: break
            f.write(b)
    os.replace(path + ".part", path)
def bk_file(key):
    aid, durl = BK[key]
    p = os.path.join(ADIR, "bk_" + aid + ".blend")
    if os.path.exists(p) and os.path.getsize(p) > 1000: return p
    h = dict(UA); h["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + KEY
    q = durl + "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode({"scene_uuid": str(uuid.uuid4())})
    fp = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(q, headers=h), timeout=60).read().decode())["filePath"]
    fetch(fp, p); return p
sc = bpy.context.scene
sc.render.engine = "BLENDER_EEVEE"; sc.render.resolution_x = 640; sc.render.resolution_y = 480
sc.render.image_settings.file_format = "JPEG"
os.makedirs("pr", exist_ok=True)
for key in BK:
    try:
        p = bk_file(key)
        for o in list(bpy.data.objects): bpy.data.objects.remove(o, do_unlink=True)
        with bpy.data.libraries.load(p, link=False) as (df, dt):
            dt.objects = list(df.objects)
        objs = [o for o in dt.objects if o]
        for o in objs: sc.collection.objects.link(o)
        bpy.context.view_layer.update()
        mn = Vector((1e9,)*3); mx = Vector((-1e9,)*3)
        for o in objs:
            if o.type != "MESH": continue
            for c in o.bound_box:
                w = o.matrix_world @ Vector(c); mn = Vector(map(min, mn, w)); mx = Vector(map(max, mx, w))
        acts = [(a.name, tuple(int(x) for x in a.frame_range)) for a in bpy.data.actions]
        info = {"key": key, "n": len(objs), "types": sorted({o.type for o in objs}), "dims": [round(x, 3) for x in (mx - mn)], "min": [round(x, 3) for x in mn],
                "names": [o.name for o in objs][:12], "actions": acts[:6], "mb": round(os.path.getsize(p) / 1e6, 1)}
        out.append(info)
        # still
        ctr = (mn + mx) / 2; size = max(mx - mn)
        cd = bpy.data.cameras.new("c"); cam = bpy.data.objects.new("c", cd); sc.collection.objects.link(cam)
        cam.location = ctr + Vector((size * 1.3, -size * 1.6, size * 0.9)); cam.rotation_euler = (ctr - cam.location).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
        sc.camera = cam
        ld = bpy.data.lights.new("s", "SUN"); ld.energy = 4; ls = bpy.data.objects.new("s", ld); sc.collection.objects.link(ls); ls.rotation_euler = (0.8, 0.2, 0.5)
        if not sc.world: sc.world = bpy.data.worlds.new("w")
        sc.world.use_nodes = True; sc.world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[0].default_value = (0.3, 0.3, 0.35, 1)
        sc.render.filepath = os.path.abspath("pr/%s.jpg" % key); bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
    except Exception as e:
        out.append({"key": key, "err": str(e)[:200]})
json.dump(out, open("probe.json", "w"), indent=1)
print("PROBE DONE")
EOF_PY
